title: US Car Shipping Prices, Transit Times and Broker Data
description:
Real car shipping quote statistics, price index, transit times and FMCSA broker counts by state (Transportli). CC BY 4.0.

Aggregate tables with a source_url column on every row that points to the Transportli page explaining the numbers. These are quotes and posted prices, not booked prices. Canonical source and method: https://transportli.com/auto-transport/price-index/. Also on Hugging Face: Transportli/us-car-shipping-prices.
